verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust/Axum web framework that users install with cargo and run on their own servers, so it holds no user data of its own. Choosing a storage region or residency is a question for hosted services, not for a framework library. Where data lives is set by wherever the user deploys their app, and nothing in the evidence shows a Proa-hosted storage offering that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
